supported_scope: The App provides native MCP server management. Authentication and permission configuration are documented; connecting an added server remains excluded.
unestablished_scope: Correctness, availability and permissions of any particular third-party service
required_setup: Use App Customizations to configure an MCP server only in a separately scoped integration profile.
constraints: Native protocol support does not make every connected service part of the baseline.
